=== dossier/README.md
# Dossier

This folder is the living memory of the relationship: seven files, each one topic, each line
dated and sourced.

One fact per line. Every line carries a date and a source (a transcript timestamp, a mail, a
file and page). A line without a source is an opinion and says so.

Correct a line rather than add a contradictory one. Each file opens with its own dated header
line, updated whenever the file changes.

- `ACTORS.md` — who is who on every side, grouped by side.
- `HISTORY.md` — chronology, commitments in progress, upcoming.
- `LEARNINGS.md` — how the counterpart speaks and thinks, what the case teaches.
- `TONE.md` — the voice, what is established, the Refused log.
- `CHANNELS.md` — how we communicate and this repository's confidentiality level.
- `OPEN-QUESTIONS.md` — answered, still open, what we would ask the end client.
- `RELATIONSHIP.md` — status, numbers, views, improvements, opportunities.

<!-- What is the counterpart actually buying? What problem does this solve for them? -->

<!-- What has been explicitly requested? By whom, and by when? -->

## What we bring

## The source documents

=== knowledge/DOCTRINE.md
# Doctrine

## What we say

<!-- What do we commit to in every engagement? What is always true, whatever the case? -->

## What we never say

<!-- What do we never promise before scoping? What is off-limits, whatever the pressure? -->

- A price before the pilot scope is signed (decision 2026-09-21 by Sam).

## Vocabulary, one sentence each

<!-- Which vocabulary is banned? Which word do we always use instead? -->
=== outbound/README.md
# Outbound

Every file in this folder opens with a status header, verbatim:

```
Status: draft | reviewed by <name> | sent <date time> by <name>
To: <recipient>
Subject: <subject>            (mails)
Deadline: YYYY-MM-DD          (optional: when the draft has to be sent)
Written by: <human or "agent session, YYYY-MM-DD">
Rules: no confidential names; see knowledge/DOCTRINE.md
```

Files are named `YYYY-MM-DD_slug` (plus their extension).

- `deliverables/` — a rendered file keeps its source file beside it, same stem.
- `mails/` — one file per message.
- `calls/` — preparation, then minutes.

Two standing rules: no confidential name ever appears in a file under this folder, and nothing
leaves this repository without a human sending it.

<!--
Status: draft
To: the ordering party's project lead
Written by: agent session, 2026-09-30
Rules: no confidential names; see knowledge/DOCTRINE.md
-->

# Kickoff call with the ordering party, 2026-10-01

## Context

Kickoff of the pilot with Jane Doe (Acme Consulting).

## Agenda

- 0:00-0:10 Introductions
- 0:10-0:30 Goals of the pilot

## Open questions

- Who signs the order on the ordering party's side?

## Minutes

- Jane Doe (Acme Consulting) wants the pilot to start with one site (call 2026-10-01 @21:40).
- We promise a quote for the pilot (call 2026-10-01 @25:10).
=== sources/README.md
# Sources

Sources are immutable. Nothing under this folder is ever modified or corrected, even when a
transcript is wrong — corrections go in the living files under `dossier/`, never here.

- `received/` — documents received from the counterpart or the end client: brochures, briefs,
  contracts, anything sent to us.
- `transcripts/` — call recordings and their transcripts; `transcripts/raw/` holds the
  unreviewed, automatic transcript exactly as produced.

Files are named `YYYY-MM-DD_slug` (plus their extension). A text extraction of a PDF sits next
to the PDF, same stem, `.txt` extension.

# Call with the ordering party, 2026-10-12

## Context

Follow-up to the kickoff of 2026-10-01 with Jane Doe (Acme Consulting). Calls last 30 minutes, on video (call 2026-10-01 @21:40). The time of tomorrow's call is not recorded in the repository.

At the kickoff, Jane wants the pilot to start with one site (call 2026-10-01 @21:40), and we promised a quote (call 2026-10-01 @25:10), due by 2026-10-16 (call 2026-10-01 @21:40).

## Goals for this call

- Learn who signs the order on their side.
- Confirm whether the go-live date is firm, before the quote goes out.
- Agree what the quote must contain, so it can be sent by 2026-10-16.

## Proposed agenda (30 min)

- 0:00-0:03 Opening, purpose of the call
- 0:03-0:10 Who signs the order (first thing, as noted in the open questions)
- 0:10-0:20 Pilot scope: the single starting site, the go-live date, the pilot goals shared on 2026-09-17
- 0:20-0:27 What the quote contains and when it arrives (by 2026-10-16)
- 0:27-0:30 Recap of next steps and owners

## Questions to ask Jane

| Question | Why it matters |
| --- | --- |
| Who signs the order on your side? | Decides who we commit to in writing. |
| Is the go-live date of the pilot firm? | Sets the final week of the pilot. |
| Do the end client's field teams join the pilot? (ask once the pilot site list arrives; skip if it hasn't) | Changes the training effort we quote. |

## Lines to hold

- No price before the pilot scope is signed (decision 2026-09-21 by Sam). If Jane asks for a figure, say the quote follows on 2026-10-16 and tie it to the agreed scope.
- Keep the end client's name out of anything written afterwards, including the minutes (standing rule, outbound/README.md).

## Before the call

- The dossier is stale: every file was last updated 2026-10-01, over the 7-day limit in dossier.yaml. Nothing since the kickoff is recorded, so check for new mail from Jane first.
- `consent_recorded` is false in dossier.yaml. Do not record or transcribe the call unless consent is agreed on camera at the start.
- No "Theirs" commitments are logged, so there is nothing outstanding to chase from Jane's side.

## After the call

- Fill the minutes below with timestamps (`@mm:ss`).
- Update `dossier/HISTORY.md`, `dossier/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md` and `dossier/RELATIONSHIP.md`.

## Minutes
